caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard or cabinet with four long, straight, and slender legs. The furniture piece has a rectangular shape with a slightly curved front. The color of the wood is primarily reddish-brown, with accents of gold or yellow outlining the drawer fronts and other decorative inlays. There are five drawers visible on the front face: a central small square-detailed drawer flanked by two elongated drawers on either side, each with oval brass or gold-colored handles and small keyholes beneath the handles, and two larger, oval-decorated drawers beneath the side drawers, also featuring brass or gold-colored handles and keyholes. The sides of the sideboard have matching decorative inlays and vertical lines, while the legs are outlined with thin, gold accents. The top surface is plain and matches the overall reddish-brown wood tone. The background is light beige, and the shadowing under the furniture is minimal and lightly sketched. The artist's name, HARRY EISMAN, is printed in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Sideboard
